name: Simple Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, a message calls new gnome warriors to Anvilmar. Sten Stoutarm passes along Thran Khorman’s summons, inviting trained fighters to learn the arts of war and prepare to reclaim Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar
sections.body: As you help Sten Stoutarm drive off troggs and boars in Coldridge Valley, he receives a short message for a young gnome warrior. Thran Khorman, a veteran trainer in Anvilmar, sees promise in the refugee fighter. He calls the newcomer to the central hall to begin martial instruction.

sections.title: A Pledge of Solidarity
sections.body: Dwarven trainers may tease gnome warriors about their size, but Thran Khorman takes their loss seriously. He asks them to imagine how dwarves would feel if Ironforge fell to the Dark Irons. Thran has pledged to help the exiled gnomes, and he will teach them the arts of war until they are ready to reclaim their home.

faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm hands gnome warriors a note in Coldridge Valley, directing them to Thran Khorman, the warrior trainer in Anvilmar’s great hall.
Thran Khorman sends the memorandum through Sten Stoutarm to promising fighters helping the mountaineers.

faq.q: Why does Thran Khorman train gnome warriors?
faq.answer: Thran Khorman pledged to help the exiled gnomes. He respects their resolve and understands their loss, comparing Gnomeregan’s fall to Ironforge being conquered by the Dark Irons.

faq.q: Where do I find Thran Khorman?
faq.answer: You can find Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar’s main hall, in Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh.
Sten Stoutarm is a dwarven mountaineer outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He coordinates the defense against aggressive boars and invading troggs.

faq.q: Why are gnomes starting in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell and was irradiated, surviving gnomes fled as refugees into dwarven lands. Anvilmar and Ironforge have opened their doors to shelter them while they rebuild their forces.

angles.text: As a gnome warrior, you begin your combat education under the veteran arms masters of Ironforge.
As a gnome, you carry the memory of exile from Gnomeregan and the resolve to train soldiers who can reclaim your irradiated city.
As a dwarf, you see Thran Khorman treat the gnomes’ plight with the same seriousness as dwarven feuds, showing solidarity with displaced allies.
